finalText:
**Green now.** All 625 tests pass.

Only 3 cases were really broken, all in `orderTotal`. It took the discount off correctly. But it charged tax on the full price, not the discounted one. So it overcharged whenever both were non-zero.

The fix reuses `applyTax` on the discounted amount:

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```
